/** @param {'en'|'es'} language @param {keyof typeof translations.en} key @param {Record<string, string|number>} [values] */
export function translate(language, key, values = {}) {
  return translations[language][key].replace(/\{(\w+)\}/g, (_, name) => String(values[name] ?? `{${name}}`))
}

{
  "name": "context-canary",
  "displayName": "Context Canary",
  "version": "1.2.0",
  "description": "Development test entry for the Context Canary marketplace; installs use plugins/context-canary.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Nachx639",
    "url": "https://github.com/Nachx639"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "types": "./plugins/context-canary/types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "word": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Canary word",
      "description": "Start each final reply with this word or emoji. Run /canary setup after changing it.",
      "default": "🐤"
    },
    "autoCompact": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Automatic compaction",
      "description": "Compact after a missing sentinel; disable for notifications only.",
      "default": true
    },
    "cooldownMinutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Recovery window (minutes)",
      "description": "A second death within this window locks automatic recovery until /clear. Zero disables the window.",
      "default": 30,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 10080
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Interface language",
      "description": "English or Spanish. This API has no UI locale accessor.",
      "default": "en",
      "options": [
        "en",
        "es"
      ]
    },
    "size": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Canary size",
      "description": "tiny (3 terminal rows), small (4), normal (6) or large (8).",
      "default": "small",
      "options": [
        "tiny",
        "small",
        "normal",
        "large"
      ]
    },
    "info": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Text beside the canary",
      "description": "none: only the bird (default). status: 'Canary alive/dead'. details: status, streak, death and recovery notes.",
      "default": "none",
      "options": [
        "none",
        "status",
        "details"
      ]
    },
    "checkpoints": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Checkpoints in CLAUDE.md",
      "description": "0 (default): only the rule. 1 to 5: /canary setup spreads code words through CLAUDE.md and every answer must carry them, so the canary samples the whole file and says which part was lost.",
      "default": 0,
      "min": 0,
      "max": 5
    }
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Nachx639/context-canary",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Nachx639/context-canary",
  "keywords": [
    "canary",
    "context",
    "claude-code",
    "mod",
    "pixel-art",
    "compaction"
  ]
}
